locked.title: This document is encrypted
locked.body: Enter its password to read and edit it. The password never leaves your browser and cannot be recovered.

enable.title: Encrypt this document
enable.body: The content is encrypted in your browser with this password. The server only stores unreadable data.
enable.limits: The title, tags and attached files are not encrypted, and the content of an encrypted document is not searchable.
enable.understand: I understand that if I lose this password the content cannot be recovered.

change.title: Change password
change.body: The document is encrypted again with the new password. The old one stops working.

password.label: Password
password.hint: At least {{min}} characters. Use a phrase only you know.

manage.title: Encryption
manage.body: This document is encrypted. Its content is readable only with its password, which this app never stores.

remove.title: Remove encryption?
remove.body: The content will be stored as plain text again and will be searchable.

errors.wrongPassword: Wrong password, or the document was altered.
errors.unsupported: This document was encrypted with a newer version of the app and cannot be opened here.
errors.malformed: The encrypted content is damaged and cannot be read.
